# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QA agent (fleet, Testing Agent MAIN) | **NexusAI RD-333 PASS 1 (tier 2 + BROWSER)** — `faae2d6` on `24d472e` (2026-09-06 06:05→06:26 AEST, ~21 min; three worktrees at absolute paths, symlink-farmed node_modules from a byte-identical lockfile, Playwright Chromium 151 over its own static serve on an ephemeral loopback port, 12 PNGs + 3 measurement JSONs + the instrument; builder checkout read-only; listeners 26 → 24; the only outbound traffic three Bootstrap CDN pins each verified against the pages' own SRI `integrity=`) | 1 | **1.00** | 1.00 | **PASS / GO with eleven claims re-derived in a real engine at BOTH SHAs, most to three decimals, on an 88-row table against the builder's 57 — it added the active state and both navbar-brand modes rather than measuring only what it was handed, and composited the ground from the element OUTWARD through every ancestor, branching per gradient stop plus a computed midpoint rather than an average. Six tampers, each shown applied and restored byte-identical: T1 reproduces the builder's own central catch exactly (the 'does NOT reach dark' test stays GREEN while dark moves 5.140 → 17.042 on 10 rows), and T3-control proves the `<link>`-TAG match load-bearing by showing a bare-filename test would red on a correct cascade. Brand table with ZERO OFF-GUIDE and no token minted — the 09-02 style-guide leg done as a table, not a claim. Found F1, a Minor with teeth: the two NEW guards match the BARE FILENAME three tests after the same file forbids it, reproduced by replacing a real link with a comment that merely NAMES the file — both guards green while the page renders 2.358. Ruled the jsdom 1.05 inverse as CORRECT-BY-MEASUREMENT rather than reaching for a NO GO. 🔴 **A MANDATORY RETRACTION of its own first-pass figures, unprompted, with both causes named — it sampled 90 ms into a 0.15 s colour transition and its ground walk started at `parentElement` — plus a third self-caught fault where a shell-escaping error returned −1 for every probe and READ AS A CLEAN RESULT. Its replacement evidence is stronger than the claim it withdrew.** NOT-TESTED led with the application itself and named two LATENT gaps neither shipping today.** |
| Datasec/NexusAI agent | **S39 — the RD-333 + RD-204-navbar round** (`24d472e` → `faae2d6`, 2026-09-05 19:3x→19:59Z; the light navbar rule on brand tokens, the coverage guard extended to `.navbar-dark`, the BEFORE/AFTER browser pass, three hash-checked pairs) | 1 | **0.85** | 0.85 | **Every arithmetic figure confirmed by an independent engine, most to three decimals; the rule swept rest + hover + focus rather than the one state the gate named; the coverage guard — not a three-page list — decides the page set; brand tokens only with no token minted, which the tester's own brand table then proved ZERO OFF-GUIDE; RD-204 JOINED by name with three of four criteria correctly left open rather than absorbed; and the round's best act is a self-catch it filed against itself — its own test named 'the rule does NOT reach dark' PASSED while the light rule's (0,4,0) hover/focus outranked dark's (0,3,1) and repainted it, because the test compared SOURCE ORDER and never asked what was painted. It found and reported the defect its own instrument was blind to.** Deductions: F1 — the two NEW population guards match the bare filename three tests after the same file spells out 'MATCH THE `<link>` TAG, NEVER THE BARE FILENAME … third instance in this class today', so a comment naming the file defeats both while the page renders Bootstrap's 2.358; F2 — the sheet's 'WHY IT DOES NOT TOUCH DARK' paragraph reaso

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-20 ~09:4x — Secuura/Kintsugi: two dev-box calls from s50 (both small)
> **(1) Seeded `*123` accounts vs unique credentials on the dev box.** The stack ships
> demo's seeded logins; scanners were probing the host within MINUTES of 443 opening.
> Rec: unique credentials (one session's work, agent can generate + record properly).
> **(2) Wallet mnemonic backup location.** Agent correctly refused to write into demo's
> Key Vault on its own authority. Rec: NO dev secrets in demo's vault — it is a
> faucet-funded test wallet, cheap to regenerate; backup waits for Kintsugi's own vault
> if ever needed. One word each.
> *(Also pending your hands: the faucet minute — address + steps on the panel.)*

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-20 ~08:4x — Secuura: does Stuart's "$5000 Founders credits live"
> actually move the 6 Sep expiry? (portal-only check, ~2 min, YOUR eyes)
> Stuart posted on KS-601 (08-19 00:58Z, with screenshot): "Founder credits are live

> 6 Sep expiry** — and 6 Sep has been the only dated clock on Kintsugi. The credits
> API 404s for the scoped SP (verified 08-19), so only the portal billing view can
> answer: do the $5000 credits REPLACE/extend the expiring grant, or sit alongside
> it? **Ask: one look at the billing view.** Until you rule, every record keeps the
> 6 Sep clock standing — s50 flagged it precisely so the screenshot does not silently
> read as "the clock moved."

> already ON DEMO (#666 merged 08-12, shipped with the 08-14 discharge) while KS-584's
